summary:
# Project Summary

Our project is an interactive  simulation designed to give players an immersive experience of a space mission. The experience begins aboard a space station, where players prepare for deployment to the Moon. Once deployed, players take control of a lunar rover and navigate the Moon's surface, exploring the environment through a driving simulation featuring realistic 3D models and environments.

As players progress, an informative cutscene introduces the rover's purpose, explaining its functions, capabilities, and role in lunar exploration. By combining interactive gameplay, realistic models, and educational storytelling, our project aims to help people better understand how lunar rover missions operate and the importance of robotic exploration in space.
details:
Project Title: Space Exploration Simulation

Project Description:

Our project is an interactive simulation that allows the player to go on interactive missions. Players begin aboard a space station before being deployed to the Moon, where they take control of a lunar rover and explore the lunar surface.

The simulation features realistic 3D models, an interactive rover-driving experience, and an educational cutscene explaining the rover's purpose, functions, and importance in lunar exploration.

Key Features:

  • Space station starting environment.
  • Deployment sequence to the lunar surface.
  • Interactive lunar rover driving simulation.
  • Realistic 3D models and environments.
  • Educational cutscene explaining the what

Purpose:

Our goal is to make space exploration more accessible and engaging through an interactive experience. Rather than simply presenting information about space exploration, we allow players to experience a simplified version of space missions themselves.

Platform: Roblox Studio.

Target Audience: Students, Young minds , space enthusiasts, and anyone interested in learning about lunar exploration.

Educational Value:

The project introduces players to lunar rover operations and demonstrates how robotic vehicles can support exploration of the Moon's surface.
